interpretation: The actual355 API36 receipt reports an internal8192-character scan limit in record3of11, not a tail-boundary rejection. The conditional tail-inventory design is not adopted by this fix.
The helper now inspects more of an already captured bounded string; it does not request more platform data or enlarge raw capture limits.
The direct input limit and scanning limit count UTF-16 code units. The capture ceiling counts bytes; they share a numeric cap, not identical units.
A complete parsed candidate is still only post-failure text evidence and cannot authorize BACK, confirmation or a screenshot.
